channel.title: Transportation – HxGN Spotlight
channel.description: Hexagon’s platform for original stories from opinion leaders and customers

item.title: Operational Technology (OT) cybersecurity – the vital next step in digitalisation (Part 3)
item.dc:creator: Jason Makar
item.description: In the third episode of our 'Operational Technology (OT) cybersecurity – the vital next step in digitalisation' podcast series, we discuss the importance of choosing the right strategic cybersecurity program for critical infrastructure.

item.title: Predicting traffic accidents in Chattanooga, TN
item.dc:creator: Jason Makar
item.description: One of the most common, yet most dangerous, events that people face every day is driving. But what if city planning and safety departments could predict and see where traffic accidents were going to happen?

item.title: Autonomous road trains for long haul mining
item.dc:creator: Jason Makar
item.description: In long haul mining, resource extraction in remote areas is a challenge with the high cost of transporting materials and labour, not to mention travel-fatigued drivers manually operating road trains. Autonomous road trains can solve these challenges.

item.title: The Mayflower Autonomous Ship has landed!
item.dc:creator: Jason Makar
item.description: Now that the Mayflower Autonomous Ship (MAS) has successfully completed its maiden voyage across the Atlantic, it's time to check in with the project's team leads. In this episode of HxGN Radio, they provide fascinating details about the voyage and what’s next for the project.

item.title: How do we enable an autonomous and sustainable future?
item.dc:creator: Jason Makar
item.description: Achieving autonomy across industries and applications is vital to sustainability through lower carbon emissions, reduced waste, increased productivity and, above all, ensuring the safety of people. But how do we get there?

item.title: Location Intelligence: Streamlining transportation efforts in Zürich
item.dc:creator: Jason Makar
item.description: In this episode of Location Intelligence we talk to VBZ, the public transport operator in Zürich, about how it uses Hexagon's geospatial solutions to optimise their transportation efforts.

item.title: For women in leadership, all roads lead to technology
item.dc:creator: Brian Tidwell
item.description: With the recent celebration of International Women’s Day, businesses from across the spectrum of industries are highlighting the exceptional work and priceless contributions of the women who help their companies to grow and thrive.

item.title: More traffic on the tracks
item.dc:creator: Jason Makar
item.description: In this episode of HxGN Radio, we discuss how rail companies can keep customers and cargo safe, while doing more with a finite set of tracks.

item.title: The bedrock foundation for any change implementation
item.dc:creator: Jason Makar
item.description: In this episode of Solving Problems with Technology, hear from culture innovators Corbins Electric and how they transformed their organisation's success by changing to a culture and people-first mindset as the starting point of their digital transformation journey.

item.title: Lessons learned from the world of sports
item.dc:creator: Jason Makar
item.description: In this episode of HxGN Radio, we discuss what city leaders can learn from the shifting landscape of sports leagues. We also talk about how money, short-term thinking and politics can doom even the most well-intentioned initiatives.
